name: shell_exec
title: Execute Shell Command
description: Execute a command in the shell reported by shell_status. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to user home.

name: shell_batch
title: Execute Bounded Shell Batch
description: Execute up to 12 local shell commands in one MCP call. Sequential by default; explicitly independent commands may run in parallel (up to 4). Uses the existing shell_exec policy.

parallel.description: Default false. Enable only for independent commands.

name: process_batch
title: Execute Shell-Free Process Batch
description: Run up to 12 direct executable/argv commands without shell startup or interpolation. Sequential by default; at most four independent commands may run concurrently.

file.description: Executable name or absolute executable path; Windows .cmd/.bat unsupported.

parallel.description: Only use for independent jobs. Defaults false.

name: shell_status
title: Shell Host Status
description: Report host health, platform, shell, current working directory, and Node.js version.

name: python_status
title: Python Interpreter Status
description: Report whether a local Python interpreter is available and which quick-validation packages can be imported.

name: python_exec
title: Execute Python Code
description: Run short Python code for calculation, reasoning checks, and small data transformations. Do not install packages, access sensitive local files, or use network access.

code.description: Short Python code to execute. Keep it focused on computation or validation.

name: local_skill_preview
title: Preview Local Skill Folder
description: Read SKILL.md files, nearby text resources, and script file manifests from a local Skill folder. Does not execute local code.

rootPath.description: Absolute local folder path that contains one or more SKILL.md files.

selectedPaths.description: Optional SKILL.md paths relative to rootPath. When omitted, previews all detected Skills up to the limit.

name: local_folder_pick
title: Pick Local Folder
description: Open the operating system folder picker and return the absolute path selected by the user.

title.description: Optional prompt shown in the native folder picker.

defaultPath.description: Optional local folder path to use as the initial picker location.

name: local_file_stat
title: Inspect Local File
description: Return whether a local path exists, whether it is a file or directory, its size, and its last modified timestamp.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative local path to inspect.

name: local_file_read
title: Read Local Text File
description: Read a UTF-8 local text file in character windows so large files can be fetched in chunks.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative local file path to read.

name: local_file_write
title: Write Local Text File
description: Write UTF-8 text to a local file without shell quoting. Supports overwrite or append and can create parent directories.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative local file path to write.

content.description: UTF-8 text content to write exactly as provided.

append.description: When true, append to the file instead of overwriting it.

create_directories.description: When true, create missing parent directories. Default true.

name: shell_session_begin
title: Open Persistent Shell Session
description: Start a long-lived shell session whose working directory, environment, and resident child processes (e.g. OfficeCLI resident mode) survive across later shell_session_exec calls. Use it for multi-step workflows where separate shell_exec calls would lose state. Returns a session_id to pass to subsequent calls.

cwd.description: Initial working directory. Defaults to user home.

env.description: Additional environment variables to set on the session shell.

shell.description: Shell binary to use. Defaults to the shell reported by shell_status.

name: shell_session_exec
title: Run Command in Persistent Shell Session
description: Run a command inside a previously opened shell session (shell_session_begin). State (cwd, exports, resident processes) carries over between calls. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code like shell_exec. Sessions auto-close after an idle timeout.

command.description: The shell command to execute in the session.

name: shell_session_end
title: Close Persistent Shell Session
description: Close a persistent shell session opened by shell_session_begin and release its child process. After this, the session_id is no longer valid.

name: local_dir_list
title: List Local Directory
description: List the files and subfolders of a local directory without starting a shell. Returns structured JSON with name, type, size, and modified time.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative local directory to list.

name: local_file_search
title: Search Local Files
description: Search files under a local directory by file name or by content. The pattern is a regular expression. Content search reads only bounded, in-scope files.

path.description: Absolute or home-relative local directory to search.

pattern.description: Regular expression to match the file name (default) or each line (content=true).

content.description: When true, search inside file contents instead of file names. Default false.

max_depth.description: Maximum directory depth to walk. Default 6.

name: task_spawn
title: Start Background Task
description: Start a long-running command (dev server, build, watcher, daemon) detached from the shell so it does not block other tool calls. Returns a task_id.

command.description: The command to run in the background.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for the task. Defaults to the command itself.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to user home.

env.description: Additional environment variables to set on the task.

name: task_status
title: Check Background Task Status
description: Report a background task state (running/exited/failed/killed), exit code, and the recent stdout/stderr tail window.

tail_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of stdout/stderr tail to return. Default 128000.

name: task_kill
title: Stop Background Task
description: Best-effort forceful termination of a background task and its process tree. POSIX uses a process group; Windows uses bounded taskkill /T /F because Node does not expose a Job Object.

name: task_list
title: List Background Tasks
description: List every background task currently known to the host, running or finished.
